A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before the
first track.

What size event can the venue host?+

Koa’s Events currently publishes a maximum of 100 people. Share your projected attendance and proposed layout so we can review the fit. Larger attendance must be specifically confirmed and approved before promotion or ticket sales.

Can we bring our own production team?+

Tell us who you’re working with and send your production requirements. We’ll review equipment, power, access, setup, and vendor arrangements with you before the event is confirmed.

What about sound, event hours, and equipment?+

Sound requirements and event hours are reviewed for each proposal. Include your planned set times and technical needs. Stage, PA, lighting, generators, and staffing are included only when specifically listed in your agreed scope.

How do we get a quote or arrange a site visit?+

Email your concept, preferred dates, estimated attendance, and production needs. The venue team will discuss availability, a site visit, and a tailored quote. An inquiry does not reserve a date.
